bugs.error_message: Μασούτης scraper finds 0 products — card selector .product-item, .col-product does not exist on page
bugs.root_cause: STORE_CONFIGS Μασούτης used .product-item/.col-product CSS class selectors but actual DOM uses div.product. Price selector .price also wrong — actual elements are .pStartPrice and .pDscntPrice
bugs.fix: Changed card to '.product', price to '.pStartPrice', img to '.productImage, .catImgCont img, img'. Added Masoutis special-case price extraction block in extractDataInBrowser to handle discounted (.pDscntPrice) vs regular (.pStartPrice) prices

bugs.error_message: Γαλαξίας scraper finds 0 products — .product-card CSS class does not exist (Angular custom element)
bugs.root_cause: STORE_CONFIGS Γαλαξίας card selector was '.product-card, .col' (CSS class) but Galaxias uses Angular SSR with <product-card> custom element. The dot prefix selects class=product-card which doesn't exist.
bugs.fix: Changed card to 'product-card' (tag selector for Angular custom element), name to 'a.text-black-i', img to 'img[src*="galaxias.shop/api/media"], img[src*="galaxias"]'

bugs.error_message: AI Meal Plan returns 500 error 'Δεν βρέθηκε κανένα AI API key στο .env' when only ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set
bugs.root_cause: Early key-check condition only tested GEMINI_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY, BYTEZ_API_KEY — did NOT include ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. So users with only Claude configured got a false 500 error.
bugs.fix: Added !process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to the condition so it only errors when ALL four providers are missing

bugs.error_message: Meal plan JSON parse failed / truncated for 7-day plans with Claude
bugs.root_cause: callClaude had max_tokens: 8096 which is insufficient for a full 7-day meal plan with 6 meal slots/day × 2 options each (~9000+ tokens output)
bugs.fix: Increased max_tokens to 16000 in callClaude function

bugs.error_message: GymBeam recipes return 0 ingredients — parseGymBeamRecipe returned cleanIngredients/cleanInstructions (undefined variables)
bugs.root_cause: parseGymBeamRecipe's return statement used `cleanIngredients` and `cleanInstructions` variable names from a different function (parsePanosRecipe) instead of the local `ingredients` and `instructions` variables
bugs.fix: Fixed return statement to use correct variable names: ingredients and instructions

bugs.error_message: GymBeam product-promo lines ('Αλεύρι αμυγδάλου - GymBeam') appear in recipe ingredients list
bugs.root_cause: Browser-side ingredient filter in parseGymBeamRecipe only blocked lines STARTING with 'GymBeam|BIO [A-Z]' but not lines ENDING with '- GymBeam'. isRecipeNoiseLine was not called on the browser-extracted ingredients.
bugs.fix: Added sLower.includes('gymbeam') check in browser-side filter. Strengthened isRecipeNoiseLine with rawLower check for all GymBeam variants. Added section-header pattern to isRecipeSectionLine.

bugs.error_message: TheMealDB shows English titles: Budino Di Ricotta, Chicken Alfredo Primavera, Fettuccine Alfredo, Chilli prawn linguine
bugs.root_cause: These titles were missing from the MEAL_NAMES_GR static dictionary. The AI batch translation fallback should catch them but the static dict is the first line of defense.
bugs.fix: Added 20 missing titles to MEAL_NAMES_GR: 9 Italian (Budino Di Ricotta, Fettuccine Alfredo, Chicken Alfredo Primavera, etc.) and 11 Others (Chilli prawn linguine, Thai Green Curry, Jerk Chicken, etc.)

bugs.error_message: Search for 'ξύδι' returns no results — user types with upsilon (υ) but products stored with iota (ι)
bugs.root_cause: normalize() strips diacritics via NFD: 'ξύδι'→'ξυδι' (U+03C5) but 'ξίδι'→'ξιδι' (U+03B9). υ and ι are different code points even though they sound identical in modern Greek.
bugs.fix: Replaced greekUpsilonFold() with full iotacism system: greekIotaCanonical() (η,υ→ι for scoring) + buildPhoneticRegex() ([ηιυ] char-class for DB queries). Now scoreMatch() and scoreMultiWord() use iota-canonical for all comparisons. MongoDB queries use phonetic regex so ONE query matches all η/ι/υ variants bidirectionally. Added 'γατοτρ|σκυλοτρ' to PET_MARKERS. Raised score filter from >5 to >10.

bugs.error_message: 'Γίνεται συγχονισμός με τον server...' banner shows continuously/repeatedly
bugs.root_cause: checkStatus() poll (runs every 15s) called setIsServerWaking(true) whenever status endpoint was slow (>3s) or failed. Since the server is already awake during polling, this was always a false positive.
bugs.fix: Removed setIsServerWaking() calls from checkStatus(). Server waking state is now only controlled by the recipe fetch wakeTimer, which is the legitimate startup case.

bugs.error_message: Blue focus outline rectangle appears around search bar when user clicks/taps
bugs.root_cause: Global :focus-visible rule in index.css adds outline: 2px solid var(--accent) to ALL focused elements. The .search-input already has a box-shadow focus indicator but no outline: none override.
bugs.fix: Added outline: none !important to .search-input:focus-visible and :focus rules in App.css. Box-shadow remains as the visual focus indicator for accessibility.

bugs.error_message: Cannot find module 'mongoose' — node runAll.js fails immediately
bugs.root_cause: node_modules directory was missing (not committed to git, .gitignore'd). npm install had never been run in this environment.
bugs.fix: Ran `npm install` in smart-grocery-backend — all dependencies restored including mongoose, puppeteer, etc.

bugs.error_message: Error processing recipe 775585: Cannot access 'nutrients' before initialization
bugs.root_cause: JavaScript TDZ (Temporal Dead Zone): `const nutrients` was declared at line 249 (after the exists check), but the upsert block at lines 237-240 referenced `nutrients` before its declaration within the same block scope. `const` is hoisted but not initialized, causing the TDZ error on every recipe that already exists in DB.
bugs.fix: Moved the `nutrients` extraction block above the `Recipe.findOne()` call so it is always initialized before any reference to it.

bugs.error_message: .env with all production secrets was git-tracked (gitignore had #.env commented out)
bugs.root_cause: gitignore line for .env was commented out; .env committed with MONGO_URI, JWT_SECRET, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, SMTP_PASS, AI keys. Same in frontend repo (Google Maps key, Stripe publishable).
bugs.fix: git rm --cached .env and uncommented .env in .gitignore (both repos). Keys remain in git HISTORY — must be rotated and history scrubbed (git-filter-repo).

bugs.error_message: Admin endpoints accepted secret via query string with non-constant-time compare
bugs.root_cause: /admin/users?secret=... leaks into proxy/server logs; plain !== compare is timing-attackable; no rate limit on admin routes.
bugs.fix: isAdminAuthorized() helper: x-admin-secret header (body fallback for compat), crypto.timingSafeEqual, strictLimiter on both admin routes.

bugs.error_message: Mongoose warning: Duplicate schema index on {shareKey:1} for model User
bugs.root_cause: shareKey had unique:true AND a separate schema.index({shareKey:1}).

bugs.error_message: Regex injection + ReDoS: user input embedded unescaped in RegExp/$regex
bugs.root_cause: shareKey lookups (4 sites in auth.js), user /search name+email, prices substitute searchWord, top-offers store filter and recipes short-search built RegExp/$regex directly from user input — key=.* matched any user (enumeration), crafted patterns could throw or spin CPU
bugs.fix: Added escapeRegex + shareKeyRegex helpers in auth.js and applied escaping at all 8 sites (prices.js/mealplan.js already had escapeRegex helpers). Load-checked all modules.
